text:
ellie: Quantix is mid-demo in eu-west and we're seeing 429s + long queue times. Sales on the call asking for a temporary priority lift — can we expedite?

ops-bot: admission-control: pool=GPU-EU-WEST at 95% capacity. quantix-prod exceeding per-customer concurrency -> queued. https://redwood.internal/ops/alerts/AC-1914 :warning:

sam: On the call now, ~20 minutes left. If latency doesn't recover they may walk. They've agreed to pay for burst hours. Need either a quick whitelist or traffic shift. :pleading_face:

raj: Checking metrics — sustained queue growth and the autoscaler is throttled by AZ slot limits. Options: 1) Temp increase admission quota for quantix (eg 10->60 conc) 2) Route quantix to us-west (adds ~70-120ms RTT) 3) Spin up reserved demo nodes (isolated, costy). Which do we want?

leah: If we bump their quota, what's the risk to other tenants? Any chance of noisy-neighbor causing higher p50/p95 for the cluster?

raj: Risk exists: increasing per-customer concurrency can starve on-demand slot allocation and raise p95 by ~5-10% for other users in eu-west. Reserved nodes isolate them; that's the safer operational option but needs approval for cost. I can also patch admission to add quantix to high-priority list for a short TTL — that reduces risk compared to a permanent quota change.

neil: Finance here — we can approve ad-hoc spend for customer-facing demos up to $1k/hr if sales certifies revenue probability. Please document chargeback.

sam: They verbally committed to paid burst. Proceed with high-priority TTL patch now, then we'll provision reserved nodes for the remainder. I'll handle chargeback docs.

raj: Applying high-priority patch now. Running:```
# add quantix to high-priority admission list for 2 hours
redwoodctl admission update --project=quantix --prioritize=true --ttl=2h
```
Logs: `admission-controller: update accepted for quantix, new_concurrency_quota=60`

ops-bot: admission-control: priority update applied for quantix (ttl=2h). Queue length went from 42 -> 3 in 90s. :white_check_mark:

ellie: Customer on the call reports responses are back to normal. Huge relief. Sam — please confirm billing path so we don't eat the cost.

sam: Confirmed — I'll log the chargeback under SLS-734 and send invoice to salesops.

raj: I'll kick off reserved demo nodes (demo-burst pool) for isolation — ETA ~8 minutes to be ready. Command: `redwood infra provision --pool=demo-burst --count=4 --region=eu-west`

leah: Marking as resolved from support POV; leaving thread open until demo-burst nodes are up and billing noted.

ops-bot: infra: demo-burst-191400 created in eu-west (4 x V100). Provisioning complete.

ellie: Thanks team — closing on our side once Sam confirms chargeback posted. :thumbsup:
